summary: Search agents by machine in the Fractal web sidebar: machine:dev3 or host:dev3,dev5. Machine names ignore case and accept prefixes; commas match any listed machine, and separate tokens and the remaining search text narrow the results. Reset filters removes machine tokens and keeps the search text.
